description: This file defines the CredentialsClient interface for accessing Hono's Credentials API, including methods for retrieving credentials with various parameters and tracing support.

classes.name: CredentialsClient
classes.description: An interface for a client to access Hono's Credentials API, scoped to a specific tenant, providing methods to retrieve credentials.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves credentials for a device by type and authId, returning a Future<CredentialsObject>. Overloaded to include optional clientContext and spanContext for tracing.
